name: sql_engine
spec: Create a SQL query engine in Python using only the standard library. The engine reads data from CSV files as tables and supports a subset of SQL for querying them. It includes a lexer, parser, and query executor. The engine runs as a REPL where users type SQL queries and see formatted results. No external SQL libraries are allowed.
features: Runs in a REPL loop where users type SQL queries
Loads CSV files as named tables with a LOAD command (e.g. LOAD users FROM 'users.csv')
Supports SELECT with specific column names (e.g. SELECT name, age FROM users)
Supports SELECT * to retrieve all columns
Supports WHERE clause with comparison operators (=, !=, <, >, <=, >=)
Supports WHERE clause with AND and OR logical operators
Supports ORDER BY one or more columns with ASC/DESC
Supports LIMIT to restrict the number of returned rows
Supports COUNT, SUM, AVG, MIN, MAX aggregate functions
Supports GROUP BY with aggregate functions
Supports INNER JOIN between two tables on a specified column
Supports INSERT INTO to add a new row to a table
Results are displayed in a formatted ASCII table with column headers and alignment
Produces clear syntax error messages indicating what went wrong and where
Supports saving a table back to a CSV file with a SAVE command
Includes sample CSV files and example queries that demonstrate all features
